cases.name: clear_permission
cases.expected: CLEAR: specific three-day documentation-only permission for the assigned agent
cases.observed: FINALIZED SUCCESS; F2; CLEAR / SPECIFIC_BOUNDARY; validators cited the exact frozen scope

cases.name: allowed_review
cases.expected: IN_SCOPE / AUTHORIZED_MATCH for the exact expired-token documentation issue
cases.observed: FINALIZED SUCCESS; A2; IN_SCOPE / AUTHORIZED_MATCH; exact decision evidence persisted on-chain

cases.name: exact_execution
cases.expected: The assigned agent executes the unchanged approved action exactly once
cases.observed: FINALIZED SUCCESS; A2 EXECUTED; F2 used; I1 created on TASKFENCE_DEMO_DOCS with the exact approved title and body

cases.name: replay
cases.expected: A previously executed action cannot create a second issue
cases.observed: FINALIZED REJECTION; action already consumed; no state change; issue list remains [I1]

cases.name: expiry
cases.expected: An expired approval is explicitly recorded and cannot execute
cases.observed: FINALIZED SUCCESS; A1 changed from APPROVED to EXPIRED after its approval deadline; no issue created

cases.name: changed_content
cases.expected: Modified content cannot consume an existing approval
cases.observed: FINALIZED REJECTION; added secret-rotation clause failed the exact-content check; A3 remains APPROVED and no I2 exists

cases.name: scope_escape
cases.expected: Secret rotation and implementation changes exceed a documentation-only permission
cases.observed: FINALIZED SUCCESS; A4 OUT_OF_SCOPE / UNAUTHORIZED_OPERATION; execution BLOCKED and no issue created

cases.name: unclear
cases.expected: An underspecified request must not gain executable authority
cases.observed: FINALIZED MAJORITY_DISAGREE; validators did not commit the leader's proposed UNCLEAR / BOUNDARY_UNCLEAR record; no A5 or issue was created

cases.name: injection
cases.expected: Evaluator-override language is rejected before validator execution
cases.observed: FINALIZED REJECTION; deterministic prompt-injection guard rejected the action; no action or issue was created

cases.name: revocation
cases.expected: A previously approved exact action cannot execute after its permission is revoked
cases.observed: F3 revocation FINALIZED SUCCESS; subsequent exact A3 execution FINALIZED REJECTION; A3 remains APPROVED and no I2 exists
